# Shashank Shettar

> Software Engineer & Backend / DevOps Specialist based in Bengaluru, India.
> Builds robust backend architectures, scalable web applications, and intuitive user experiences.

## Professional Summary
Shashank Shettar (also known as Shashank G S) is a software engineer specializing in backend systems (Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Redis), modern frontend development (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS), and cloud deployments (Docker, AWS, DigitalOcean, Linux). He is currently working as a Software Engineer at Stalight Technologies.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Programming Languages**: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL
- **Backend Frameworks & Databases**: Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, RESTful API Design
- **Frontend & UI**: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Framer Motion
- **DevOps & Infrastructure**: Docker, AWS, DigitalOcean, Nginx, Linux, CI/CD, Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel
- **Specializations**: System Architecture, API Security, Performance Optimization, Agentic AI
